name: mendix-epics
description: Read and write a Mendix Epics backlog - list, search, export, create and update stories, epics and tasks - through the Mendix Epics API.

app_id.title: Mendix App ID
app_id.description: UUID of the Mendix app whose Epics backlog to use (Developer Portal > General settings, or the Team Server repository URL). Saved as the default app at session start. Leave empty to choose apps with set-app.

app_name.title: App short name
app_name.description: Name the app ID is saved under, used with --app. Defaults to 'default'.

epics_pat.title: Mendix Personal Access Token
epics_pat.description: PAT from https://user-settings.mendix.com/ with both mx:epics:read and mx:epics:write scopes. Stored in secure storage and copied at session start to the tool's own PAT store (DPAPI-encrypted on Windows). Leave empty to use set-pat instead.
